requirement: Brand and Brand builder show a translated sentence for every failure — never 'HTTP 403', the engine's raw error text, or a job named '?'

oracle.ref: PR #1181 (fix); fix evidence: #811 F-S5-008: tabs.tsx built the failed job as { host: url ?? '?', error: { code: 'HTTP 403' } } and JobProgress printed job.error.error for any untranslated code.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. refusalCode maps 401/403 to NOT_ALLOWED and a code-less refusal to UNAVAILABLE; failureText gives a sentence for every known code and job.failed.other for an unknown one; hostOfInput files an own-site refusal under the site's host, never '?'.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a refusal with no code of its own is named by its kind, never as "HTTP <status>"
every failure reads as a translated sentence; an unknown code gets the general one
the job a refusal leaves behind is named by the site it was for, never "?"
